tools.name: lookup_carrier
tools.description: Looks up a U.S. motor carrier or freight broker in FMCSA public records by USDOT number or MC number. Returns its operating authority, liability insurance and bond on file, suspension or revocation notices, and plain-English red flags, each citing the FMCSA dataset it came from. Use before booking o

tools.name: check_carrier_list
tools.description: Checks up to 25 U.S. carriers or brokers at once (USDOT numbers; MC numbers also accepted, up to 10) and returns each one's most important red flag from FMCSA public records, urgent ones first. Use to screen a carrier list or a load board shortlist.

tools.name: recent_suspension_notices
tools.description: Lists carriers and brokers FMCSA recently served an involuntary suspension notice (usually because insurance was cancelled), with the date each suspension takes effect. Until that date FMCSA still shows the company as "Active".

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "check_carrier_list" stacks urgency/override words (important, urgent). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.
